title: Tôi cần quản lý

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi cần quản lý answers the traveler question "I need the manager" in lost items, help, managers, and recovery moments. Its job is putting the need first and leaving room for the helper to confirm the detail. Expect a confirmation, a handoff, a price, or a follow-up question; then use Explore next if the reply creates another small task.
